text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Shake a leg! You're almost late for the start of class! Tardiness is the route to delinquency! Be careful!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Come on! You're way too worked up all the time! That's why your skin is looking so rough!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Wha?! My skin is… rough?! Th-that can't be…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: An unhealthy lifestyle is the route to delinquency! Am I… going to become a delinquent?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Oh! Then that makes me a star student! I follow a proper skincare routine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No way?! So the bad student here… is me?!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Erm, I dunno… But cheer up anyway! Don't fret it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O is shocked to realize she has skin issues.
